correctness.rationale: The Petersen open neighborhood of a two-subset is the three other two-subsets within the complementary three-set, yielding exactly ten disjoint-edge-support triangle facets, 10 vertices, 30 edges and 10 triangles. Every triangle has three edges of which none belongs to another triangle; ten free edge/triangle collapses leave a connected graph with 20 edges and 10 vertices, hence wedge of 11 circles integrally. The source proof explicitly decomposes the oriented C0,C1,C2 as S5-induced representations and cancels their rational Specht constituents using Pieri; independent enumeration over all 120 S5 permutations of all 50 nonempty faces reproduces reduced Lefschetz character (-11,1,1,1,1,-1,-1), i.e. the claimed H1 character. This is a rational representation, not an integral Specht-lattice splitting.
